messages:
jess: Quick sync - assembling a compact "Entrance Checklist" for multi-tier inference GA. Need rapid eyes from Docs, SRE, Pricing, and Support.

omar: TL;DR buckets?

jess: Five buckets: 1) regression & safety gate, 2) SLOs + fallback policy, 3) observability + alarms, 4) docs + runbooks, 5) pricing/quota & billing. One owner each, short pass/fail items.

leah: I can own docs/runbooks. Deliverables: one-page Quick Card, migration notes for Dedicated/Private, rollback steps, contact matrix, SDK retry example.

sam: Pricing notes: free-tier caps, committed vs burst pricing, preview credits, and explicit KV-cache billing behavior. Also add a short blurb for overage handling in trials.

omar: SLOs proposal: p95 <= 350ms (standard), p95 <= 700ms (long-context). Error rate < 0.3% (5xx + timeouts). Degradation rule: sustained p95 > 2x for 15m -> automatic model variant fallback.

deploy-bot: Note: auto-fallback requires documented circuit-breaker and verified rollback path (owner: eng-runtime).

jess: Observability must include per-model token counts, trace -> request-id mapping, and a cost burn dashboard (cost/token). Alerts: SLO burn > 60% in 5m, error spike > 0.5% in 1m.

leah: I'll prepare the Quick Card and tie docs to the checklist by EOD.

sam: Ops wants free-tier QPS <= 10 qps/account with explicit throttle message + billing link. For Dedicated trials include an overage clause and manual approval for increased capacity.

omar: Support plan: Tier 1 playbook in Customer Success + a staffed 72-hour rota after launch for the critical window. Owners: eng-platform + eng-sre.

jess: Proposed gate to flip beta -> GA: (A) all checklist items green, (B) regression smoke pass (3k prompts across critical intents), (C) SRE load test 2x expected traffic for 30m meeting p95 targets, (D) pricing page and billing link live, (E) 72-hour rota staffed.

leah: Non-negotiable from Docs: short runbook with explicit escalation steps and primary/secondary contacts.

omar: Non-negotiable: automated fallback and rollback must be tested end-to-end; no manual-only emergency paths.

sam: Non-negotiable: explicit Dedicated trial overage policy signed off by finance.

jess: Timeline: if Docs + Pricing sign off today, eng-runtime targets fallback wiring by Wed, infra dashboards by Thu, load test Fri. Reconvene tomorrow 10:00 for final go/no-go.

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled 2025-05-18 02:00 UTC - confirm rota if go.

leah: Ack - publishing Quick Card + runbook by EOD and linking checklist.

sam: I'll update pricing page and ping finance by 15:00.

omar: I'll own SLA + runbook steps. Will pair with eng-runtime for fallback test.

jess: Thanks all - I'll synthesize a one-page Entrance Checklist and drop in the launch tracker. Closing thread for now.
